**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Handle populated RowSource lists before accepting TopIndex**

For a ListBox populated through `RowSource`/`.Requery()`, the requery path fills `list_rows` but explicitly clears `collection_item_keys` in `requery_native_list_control()` (`prg_engine.cpp:6303-6314`). Consequently this count is zero even when the control has rows, so every admitted numeric `TopIndex` assignment returns success as a silent no-op. Either restrict this new arm to its documented RowSourceType 0 scope or ensure row-source rows have identities before using the key count.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
